name: io.kaidn/kaidn-mcp
description: Investigate fraud against a Kaidn tenant in natural language — explain a verdict with its evidence, investigate an email, IP or device, and work the review queue. Read-only by default.
title: Kaidn

environmentVariables.name: KAIDN_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your secret Kaidn API key, from https://kaidn.io

environmentVariables.name: KAIDN_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Override the Kaidn API base URL

environmentVariables.name: KAIDN_MCP_ALLOW_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to register the mutating tools (add_to_list, label_outcome)

environmentVariables.name: KAIDN_MCP_MAX_QUOTA_CALLS
environmentVariables.description: Ceiling on quota-consuming calls per process
